segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כׇּל שִׁיעוּרֵי חֲכָמִים בִּכְתָמִים — צָרִיךְ שִׁיעוּר לְשִׁיעוּרָן. דְּיֶלֶד אוֹ דְזָקֵן, דְּאִישׁ אוֹ דְאִשָּׁה, מְכוּסִּים אוֹ מְגוּלִּים, בִּימוֹת הַחַמָּה אוֹ בִּימוֹת הַגְּשָׁמִים.
segments.en: On the topic of the urine used to remove a blood stain, «Rabbi Yoḥanan says: All the measures of the Sages with regard to» blood «stains require a measure for their measure.» There are many types of urine, each of which has different properties, and it is unclear which is to be used. Is it urine «of a young» person «or of an old» person? Is it urine «of a man or of a woman?» Is it urine that has been kept «covered or uncovered?» Is it urine «from the summer or from the rainy season?»

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי יוחנן: כל שיעורי חכמים

edges.about: the Sages' measures for stain-removal urine are underspecified by age, sex, covering and season
edges.proposedPredicate: interpret.notes_underspecification_of — «צריך שיעור לשיעורן» — declares another party's measure itself undefined and in need of a further measure; construes/asks_meaning_of neither record the charge of vagueness

positions.claim: the Sages' measures for stains need a measure: young/old, man/woman, covered/uncovered, summer/winter
